lessonTitle: §1.6 · Từ vector sang ma trận dữ liệu
displayTitle: Tham khảo thêm · Từ vector sang ma trận dữ liệu
purpose: Bảng tra cứu nhanh cho data-matrix contract, orientation, indexing/slicing, NumPy shape semantics, centering, Gram/covariance gates, case UGV đã khóa, lỗi phổ biến và giới hạn kết luận. Artifact không thay thế bài học đầy đủ và không thêm toán học hay policy ngoài các contract đã khóa.

canonicalDataContract.columnMeaning: column j = ordered feature j across observations
canonicalDataContract.entryMeaning: x_ij = feature j of observation i
canonicalDataContract.observationVector: x^(i) in R^n, inserted as x^(i)^T
canonicalDataContract.metadataPolicy: Observation IDs and timestamps travel with rows; feature IDs, definitions and units travel with columns.
canonicalDataContract.timestampPolicy: Timestamp is observation metadata unless explicitly promoted by a new feature-engineering contract.
canonicalDataContract.warning: Equal shape is necessary for many array operations but is not sufficient for semantic compatibility.

notationLookup.meaning: observation row i with aligned ID/timestamp
feature trajectory j with aligned schema/unit
selected observation/feature block with aligned metadata
scaled matrix after declared scale policy
sample covariance only under F16 assumptions

formulaTable.name: Canonical row-observation assembly
formulaTable.shape: x^(i) in R^n; X in R^(m x n)
formulaTable.conditions: Same dimension, ordered schema, order, units and acquisition/frame contract.
formulaTable.checks: shape(X)=(m,n); rows match observations; metadata lengths agree.
formulaTable.warning: Equal length alone is not stack compatibility; do not flatten observations.

formulaTable.name: Matrix entry meaning
formulaTable.formula: x_ij = feature j of observation i
formulaTable.conditions: Row-observation convention; schema s_j and unit u_j declared.
formulaTable.checks: Resolve observation i and feature j explicitly.
formulaTable.warning: Do not swap i/j after transpose without rewriting notation.

formulaTable.name: Observation-row extraction
formulaTable.conditions: Preserve row semantics and code-index offset.
formulaTable.warning: Do not lose row metadata or claim a 1D API result is already a column matrix.

formulaTable.name: Feature-column extraction
formulaTable.conditions: Column j maps to schema s_j/unit u_j; observation order fixed.
formulaTable.warning: A feature trajectory is not one observation; mixed units need policy.

formulaTable.name: Row/column/block slicing
formulaTable.conditions: Slice observation metadata with I and feature schema/units with J.
formulaTable.checks: Numeric block and metadata lengths/order agree.
formulaTable.warning: Do not slice values while leaving stale metadata.

formulaTable.name: Convention conversion by transpose
formulaTable.shape: m x n <-> n x m
formulaTable.conditions: X is 2D; all semantic roles and formulas translated.
formulaTable.warning: Do not transpose merely to silence a dimension error.

formulaTable.name: NumPy one-dimensional transpose trap
formulaTable.warning: x.T does not create a row matrix from a 1D array.

formulaTable.name: Canonical NumPy assembly
formulaTable.warning: stack does not validate units/schema; axis=1 changes convention.

formulaTable.name: Column-observation NumPy assembly
formulaTable.conditions: Alternative convention declared and downstream formulas translated.
formulaTable.checks: Name result X_col; columns are observations.
formulaTable.warning: Do not call result canonical X while retaining row-observation prose.

formulaTable.name: Linear score per observation
formulaTable.conditions: w follows same ordered feature interface; no bias term.
formulaTable.checks: Check shape and feature-order provenance of w.
formulaTable.warning: Successful multiplication does not prove semantic validity.

formulaTable.name: Feature-feature Gram matrix
formulaTable.conditions: Row observations; preprocessing stage and scales/units declared.
formulaTable.checks: Entries are raw inner products between feature columns.
formulaTable.warning: X_raw^T X_raw is not automatically covariance.

formulaTable.name: Observation-observation Gram matrix
formulaTable.conditions: Valid common feature contract; scale appropriate for intended comparison.
formulaTable.checks: Entries are inner products between observations.
formulaTable.warning: Do not confuse with feature covariance or physical closeness under mixed units.

formulaTable.name: Feature-wise mean vector
formulaTable.conditions: One valid schema; locked case has no missing values.
formulaTable.checks: Reproduce locked mean and feature alignment.
formulaTable.warning: Do not average wrong axis or mix schema versions.

formulaTable.name: Feature-wise centering
formulaTable.conditions: mu belongs to declared reference dataset; deployment reuses approved mean unless retraining/versioning.
formulaTable.checks: Column sums approximately zero; reconstruction matches X_raw.
formulaTable.warning: Do not subtract row mean, refit live mean silently or call centering normalization.

formulaTable.name: Feature-wise scaling
formulaTable.conditions: s_j>0; scale source/version declared; policy task-justified.
formulaTable.checks: Scale vector length, positivity and provenance.
formulaTable.warning: No scale vector is locked in §1.6; do not refit live scales or claim universal benefit.

formulaTable.name: Sample covariance under explicit assumptions
formulaTable.conditions: Rows are observations; feature-wise centred; m>1; divisor m-1; no alternate weights/convention.
formulaTable.warning: Do not use X_raw^T X_raw, omit divisor or ignore API rowvar/normalization.

formulaTable.name: Feature transformation bridge
formulaTable.shape: X:m x n; A:n x p; Y:m x p
formulaTable.conditions: A matches input feature order; output feature meaning declared; no affine offset.
formulaTable.checks: Observation count m preserved; interface matches A.
formulaTable.warning: Do not write AX under row-observation convention or call every transform PCA.

formulaTable.name: Rank bound and criterion boundary
formulaTable.conditions: Numerical rank requires tolerance; physical interpretation deferred.
formulaTable.checks: For locked 8x6 case only conclude rank(X)<=6 without extra criterion.
formulaTable.warning: Do not equate rank with physical modes/useful features or software tolerance with engineering truth.

extractionLookup.metadataRule: Slice observation IDs/timestamps with rows and feature schema/units with columns; numeric slices are not self-describing.

apiOrientationLookup.gate: rename X_col and translate downstream formulas
use reshape(1,n) or reshape(n,1) for a true 2D object
w must match ordered feature interface
not covariance unless F16 assumptions hold
mixed-unit geometry requires declared scale policy

preprocessingAndDerivedGates.matrixStateRule: Keep X_raw, X_c and X_s distinct.

centering.deploymentRule: reuse approved reference mean; refit only via explicit retraining/versioning

scaling.reason: Six features use mixed units; defensible scales depend on downstream task/reference population.
scaling.forbidden: Do not invent a scale vector in §1.6.

lockedCaseLookup.scenario: eight ordered telemetry windows under one acquisition configuration
lockedCaseLookup.rankPolicy: only rank(X)<=6; no numerical/physical rank inference

troubleshootingMatrix.repair: Write semantic contract first; transpose only for explicit convention conversion.
troubleshootingMatrix.evidence: State shapes and axes before/after; translate formula too.

troubleshootingMatrix.repair: NumPy 1D transpose keeps shape (n,); use explicit reshape.
Transpose swaps semantic axes; rewrite all row/column/Gram interpretations.
troubleshootingMatrix.evidence: Locate same observation/feature before and after transpose.

troubleshootingMatrix.repair: Equal shape is structural only; schema/order/units/acquisition/version must match.
troubleshootingMatrix.evidence: Swapped-column case stacks numerically but fails contract.

troubleshootingMatrix.repair: Require orientation, IDs, schema, units and version.
troubleshootingMatrix.evidence: An unrelated 8x6 array is not UGV_TELEMETRY_8X6.

troubleshootingMatrix.repair: Column order is part of interface; permute all dependent artifacts together or reject.

troubleshootingMatrix.symptom: Correct feature name proves correct unit
troubleshootingMatrix.evidence: rpm-converted omega_left with stale rad/s label fails.

troubleshootingMatrix.repair: Require exact version/checksum agreement before use.
troubleshootingMatrix.evidence: Numerically identical V1 payload cannot be accepted as incompatible V2.

troubleshootingMatrix.repair: Slice row IDs/timestamps and feature schema/units with values.
troubleshootingMatrix.evidence: 3x3 block travels with W03-W05 and a_long/a_lat/yaw_rate.

troubleshootingMatrix.repair: Keep timestamp as metadata unless a new feature-engineering/schema contract promotes it.
troubleshootingMatrix.evidence: Appending time changes 8x6 to 8x7 and invalidates locked schema.

troubleshootingMatrix.symptom: Centering and scaling are the same
troubleshootingMatrix.repair: Centering subtracts mu; scaling divides by declared scales; vector normalization is different.
Reuse approved reference preprocessing; refit only through retraining/versioning.
troubleshootingMatrix.evidence: Separate fit from transform; independent centering changes representation.

troubleshootingMatrix.repair: X_raw^T X_raw is raw Gram; F16 needs centered X_c and divisor m-1.

troubleshootingMatrix.symptom: Mixed-unit raw columns are directly comparable
troubleshootingMatrix.repair: Geometry depends on units/scales; scale policy is task-dependent and not locked.
troubleshootingMatrix.evidence: Centering alone does not equalize feature scales.

troubleshootingMatrix.symptom: Rank equals number of physical UGV modes
troubleshootingMatrix.repair: Rank belongs to named matrix/criterion; physical modes need extra model/evidence.
Low variance in one batch does not prove task or safety irrelevance.
troubleshootingMatrix.evidence: Separate descriptive variance from downstream utility.

troubleshootingMatrix.repair: F16 only establishes covariance construction; eigenvectors/component selection remain deferred.

troubleshootingMatrix.symptom: A data audit diagnoses a fault
troubleshootingMatrix.repair: Data/model-contract evidence does not uniquely identify a physical fault.
troubleshootingMatrix.evidence: Require explicit diagnostic model and independent engineering evidence.

terminologyLookup.vi: ma trận đã chuẩn hóa thống kê

permitted: The payload is or is not semantically compatible with the locked data contract.
Under the canonical convention, rows are observations and columns are ordered features.
X_raw[2,4] is 0.08 rad/s, yaw_rate of UGV-W03.
X_raw^T X_raw is a raw feature Gram matrix, not automatically covariance.
Under F16 assumptions, C=(1/7)X_c^T X_c is a sample covariance preview.
For the 8x6 matrix, rank(X) is at most 6.
Scaling, numerical-rank criterion, PCA and diagnosis require additional declared policy/evidence.
prohibited: Two arrays are compatible because both are 8x6.
x.T turns a NumPy shape-(6,) vector into a 1x6 row matrix.
X_raw^T X_raw is the covariance matrix without centering/normalization assumptions.
A fresh live-batch mean/scale may always replace the reference preprocessing.
The UGV has six physical modes because the matrix has six columns.
The covariance preview already defines accepted principal components or retained dimension.
Low variance proves a feature is useless.
A schema/scale/variance mismatch proves a wheel, IMU or battery fault.
